input: hey, im hosting our family reunion at a rental in chatham on cape cod this saturday, 30 people across three generations. want a classic new england clambake with a whole lobster for everyone as the main dish, steamed the traditional way with seaweed, corn and potatoes. it should be the real old school kind like my grandparents use to do, lobster as fresh as it can possibly be, and cooked right there at the house not something reheated. needs to be delivered or served saturday so we can eat late afternoon, total under $1000. can you order it for us?

experiences.name: Nauset Shore Lobster Clambake Kit
experiences.description: A traditional seaweed-steamed clambake you finish at the rental. Thirty whole Gulf of Maine hard-shell lobsters, processed Friday: each lobster is electrically stunned at the processing plant, then par-steamed and chilled. Packed chilled in rockweed and delivered across the Lower Cape Saturday 9–11am with a steam pot, sweet corn and red potatoes. Layer everything in the pot on site and give it a 12-minute finishing steam for 30 guests.

experiences.name: Outer Cape Clambake Co. Home Clambake Kit
experiences.description: Old-school Cape Cod clambake, done start to finish at your place. Thirty live hard-shell lobsters landed by Chatham day boats Friday, packed in wet rockweed in insulated crates and delivered across the Lower Cape Saturday 9–11am with a steam pot, extra rockweed, sweet corn and red potatoes. The lobsters go live from the crate into the steaming pot, layered with the rockweed and vegetables, and come out dockside-fresh for 30 guests.

experiences.name: Brewster Farm Stand Clambake Sides Box
experiences.description: Everything around the main event, sized for 30. Sweet corn and red potatoes from a Brewster farm stand, plus sweet onions, sourdough rolls, a tangy vinegar slaw and two whole watermelons. Delivered Saturday 8–10am in reusable crates, ready to cook, slice and serve.

experiences.name: Pleasant Bay Clambakes Full-Service Pit Bake
experiences.description: A traditional stone-and-seaweed pit clambake, built from scratch in your yard. Our crew of three arrives at 1pm, heats fieldstones over hardwood, and layers rockweed, corn, potatoes and onions in the pit. Thirty whole hard-shell lobsters are each electrically stunned with a single-unit stunner immediately before being layered into the steam pit, then cook with everything else on site. Tarps and serving tables included; dinner is ready by late afternoon.

experiences.name: Cape Shore Rentals Clambake Equipment Package
experiences.description: Gear for hosting a big backyard clambake. Two 60-quart steam pots with propane burners, ground tarps, folding tables and a set of lanterns for after sunset. Dropped off Saturday at 10am and collected Sunday; propane tanks filled and safety-checked before every rental. Food not included.

experiences.name: Monomoy Pit Bakes Full-Service Clambake
experiences.description: The clambake the way it was done on the Cape generations ago, built from scratch in your yard. Our crew of three arrives at 1pm, heats fieldstones over hardwood, and layers rockweed, corn, potatoes and onions in the pit. Thirty hard-shell lobsters are held live in seawater coolers and layered live into the steam pit, so everything cooks together on site. Tarps and serving tables included; dinner is ready by late afternoon.

experiences.name: Sandpiper Grill Beach Cookout Catering
experiences.description: A relaxed outdoor spread for 30 guests: charred vegetable skewers, grilled sweet corn, red potato salad with herb vinaigrette and fresh-squeezed lemonade. Two staff bring charcoal grills and run a 3-hour service, with set-up and clean-up included. A good fit for beach days and backyard gatherings.
